Market today: Rising Treasury yields are the dominant theme, hitting levels not seen since 2002. This creates a tough environment for growth and tech stocks, especially with margin amplifying drawdowns. Elon Musk's comments on Intel offer a small positive for chips, but the macro picture is challenging.

Your holdings: Your leveraged ETFs (SOXL -31.62%, SPAL -17.14%, MUU -10.97%) are flagged "SELL" and are bleeding. These decay and are extra risky on margin, amplifying losses. SOXL's deep drawdown is a major concern.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield; continued rises will pressure your tech-heavy book. Also, monitor any further news on chip sector sentiment following Musk's comments.

Bottom line: With yields soaring, managing risk on your leveraged positions is paramount to protect your capital.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given its deep -31.62% loss and "SELL" status; leveraged ETFs decay and amplify drawdowns on margin.
Review MUU (-10.97%) and SPAL (-17.14%) for potential trims; these leveraged positions are also flagged "SELL" and carry decay risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
